headline: Binance freezes assets following $6.3bn hack as Bitcoin drops
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suspended withdrawals and froze assets after suffering a record $6.3 billion security breach. Following the news, Bitcoin fell to $76,000, its lowest level in six weeks.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. Security breaches of this scale erode market confidence and directly trigger broad liquidity and price declines across digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: A major breach at the largest crypto exchange prompts sell-offs and risk aversion across digital token markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
